unsupported_claims: The same-color regions arise under a low resolution parameter setting in modularity-based community detection (e.g., Louvain); the paper uses node2vec with p=1, q=0.5 and kmeans clustering.

A low resolution parameter merges densely connected groups into larger communities, while higher resolution splits them into smaller ones; none of this appears in the paper's Les Misérables case study.
rationale: The answer attributes the coloring to a resolution parameter in Louvain-style community detection, whereas the paper's setting is node2vec with p=1, q=0.5, so the core answer is wrong. It only loosely matches the paper in saying same-colored regions indicate communities.
